generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster, printed in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background, features a luminous pink donut and an eggplant with a syringe against a foggy, dark backdrop with glittering diamonds. The stylized, engraved illustration shows a luminous pink donut with a subtle holographic shimmer and tiny, almost translucent, brightly colored sprinkles. Its soft golden base barely peeks through the translucent icing. Next to it, an eggplant holds a syringe. The background features mist in a dark setting with brilliant diamonds scattered on the floor. A large, bold headline arches across the top in all caps, in a mid-century serif font. A humorous tagline appears beneath, also in a stylized font. Mid-century sparkle icons are scattered around the headline.
